name: Small but Vicious (Racial)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shoony

Benefit(s): Unlike most Shoony, you tend towards more aggressive behavior against those you are unfamiliar with. You gain a natural bite attack that deals 1d3 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
